_lisezmoi: Tous les paramètres du site vivent ici, jamais en dur dans le code (RECETTE-SITE.md §4). Chaque valeur a été relue sur la source officielle citée le 2026-10-20. La table des facteurs PLF est dans plf.json.

next.rule: 150% of the 2027 Freddie Mac national conforming loan limit, set by FHFA

plf.rounding: Expected rate rounded to the nearest 1/8 percent; age rounded to the nearest whole year (HUD HECM calculator help).

lesa.lifeTable: Regulation Z, Appendix L to Part 1026 (TALC life expectancy, column 2)

rates._note: Weekly average of the daily 10-year and 1-year Treasury par yields of October 13 to 16, 2026 (Treasury daily par yield curve, read 2026-10-20). The margin is an example to be replaced by the lender's margin: no margin is set by HUD.
